nodes.text: 6/ He knows he needs to be evaluated today, something is increasingly causing pain in his abdominal area. He’s getting over hMPV, that caused a massive AE PANS flare. We are trying to manage, I’ve alerted his docs @ Hopkins, CNMC, they don’t have much to offer than support.

nodes.author: DebK_hEDS
nodes.text: 7/ This is all difficult, especially in the context of trying to get treatment in the US healthcare system for conditions that are not well understood & easily mismanaged or brushed aside. Seeking prayers, understanding & strength for my son today as we seek answers for his pain
